_meta.source: https://uhnj.findhelp.com/ (Community Resource Guide run by University Hospital, Newark, on the findhelp platform; shared by Azra 2026-10-10)
_meta.pattern: https://uhnj.findhelp.com/{category}/all?postal={zip}  (category pages confirmed on findhelp search_results pages; subcategory slugs like food/food-pantry--newark-nj also work)
_meta.how_we_use_it: Deep links only. No scraping: the site is bot-protected and the API is an enterprise tier. For the pilot, ask University Hospital or findhelp for the Simple Search Box widget (iframe, https://www.findhelp.com/widget/v2/uhnj?ref=...) or API access.
_meta.context: findhelp lists 8,008+ programs serving New Jersey and hosted the New Jersey Social Care Summit on the Rutgers campus in September 2025 (https://company.findhelp.com/blog/2025/09/23/new-jersey-social-care-summit/).
